data.exact_reserve_text: On 14 February 2018, the managing agency entered in to an external reinsurance to close agreement ('RITC') for each of the three run-off years, which contained the specialist sports and leisure book managed by the previous owners. As a result, the assets and liabilities of these years within the balance sheet as at 31 December 2017, were transferred to Syndicate 3330's 2018 year of account managed by Coverys Managing Agency Limited. The claims provisions carried forward also include significant reserving added to the professional indemnity book during 2018, as referred to in the Claims environment section above.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2018 were GBP 116.8m. During 2018 the syndicate recorded a mix of movements: an external RITC in February 2018 transferred the run-off sports and leisure years (reducing on-balance-sheet run-off reserves), while significant additional reserving was taken in 2018 for the professional indemnity portfolio (an adverse prior-year development in that class). Separately, catastrophe activity (2017 hurricanes and earthquakes; late-2018 typhoons, US hurricanes and California wildfires) drove net catastrophe losses (net ~GBP 18.5m in 2017 and forecast net ~GBP 8.2m in 2018) which impacted the claims position. No single explicit gross prior-year release/strengthening figure is stated in the notes, and the claims reconciliation includes RITC and FX movements that distort simple year-on-year comparisons.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities - claims outstanding) 2017 comparative. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure is printed in the notes; the reconciliation in Note 3 shows P&L 'claims incurred in prior underwriting years' and other lines (RITC, FX) but does not isolate a gross PY movement in the format requested. Because of an external RITC transfer of run-off years during 2018 and FX and payment lines, calculation of a clean gross prior-year development is not possible from the available tables without additional breakdown of payments by accident year. Consequently prior_year_development_gbp_m is null.
